problem: Companion productization needs user-visible startup and long-running process budgets without creating a second sampler, supervisor or telemetry runtime.

authority.live_long_running_observation: existing XiaoYu companion_runtime_soak.py read-only psutil observation for already-authoritative desktop/backend processes

reused_outputs: graceful shutdown and residual PID/port validation

latest_upstream_checked.relevant_difference: Latest file differs mainly around NekoPower browser scenario and a port-release check; no newer Companion-specific startup/process-tree/first-chat measurement authority replaces the current-pin stack contract.

selected.mechanism: thin offline JSON normalizer and explicit budget evaluator
behavior: never launches or supervises a process
extracts only measurements already emitted by native benchmark/live soak
fails closed when a requested budget metric is absent
propagates native benchmark validation_errors and live-soak FAIL as product failures
selected.contract_gate: private_overlay/tests/test_companion_performance_budget.py executed by the existing private-overlay agent push gate
hardening: non-finite measurement values are never normalized into comparable metrics
non-finite budget bounds are rejected instead of silently bypassing comparisons
direct non-finite requested metrics fail closed
source validation failures and requested missing metrics remain product failures

acceptance: startup backend/main/memory/agent ready timings are normalized from native benchmark outputs
first chat completion is normalized from native synthetic_chat output
cold-start/avatar-host/first-chat process-tree memory is normalized from native checkpoints
long-running RSS growth/CPU/PID churn/count are normalized from existing live soak
budgets are explicit input rather than invented universal thresholds
source validation failures fail the product gate
adapter imports no psutil and creates no subprocess/process owner
ordinary agent/** pushes execute the Companion performance evaluator contract tests
the overlay contract machine-checks that the performance budget test remains in the push workflow
NaN/Infinity cannot bypass an explicit product budget
retirement_condition: Retire the thin evaluator when N.E.K.O exposes an equivalent stable product-budget verdict over its native benchmark/telemetry outputs or Companion release gating consumes that native verdict directly.
